::: {#exm-hers-spearman}
#### Spearman correlation between BMI and fasting glucose in HERS

The Pearson correlation of the ranks (@def-spearman-r),
and `cor.test()`'s Spearman test
(`exact = FALSE`, because tied values rule out the exact p-value):

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
hers_bmi <- hers |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(BMI))
cor(rank(hers_bmi$BMI), rank(hers_bmi$glucose))
cor.test(hers_bmi$BMI, hers_bmi$glucose, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
```

$r_S$ is larger than the Pearson $r$ of @exm-hers-cor:
the association is closer to monotone than to linear.
:::
